name: Sapa food guide
summary: Sa Pa eats for a cold evening: thắng cố with rượu ngô, skewers on the grills by hồ Sa Pa, and salmon at Thác Bạc. Saturday evening belongs to the market square by the stone church.
body: Eat Sa Pa as the high town, not as a second Hanoi. The stew is thắng cố, horse or buffalo with the offal, drunk with rượu ngô; the cold-night plate is the grill by the lake; the salmon comes from Thác Bạc, about 12 km toward Ô Quy Hồ.
Hours move with the season. When a door lists two clocks or two prices, both are on that door.
specialtiesLead: Highland stew, cold-night grills, salmon from the falls, and the cakes and home dishes of the villages.

sections.heading: Specialties
paragraphs: Start with thắng cố and corn wine, then work through the grills by the lake and the salmon at Thác Bạc.

spots.name: Thang co
spots.note: Horse or buffalo meat and offal stewed with thảo quả, cinnamon, and star anise, with a strong gamey smell. Drink rượu ngô with it.

spots.name: Men men
spots.note: The Mong corn staple, stone-milled and steamed twice; chewed slowly, it tastes nutty and sweet.

spots.name: Corn wine
spots.note: Highland corn wine, poured beside thắng cố and at the Cát Cát Gầu Tào stalls.

spots.name: Com lam
spots.note: Sticky rice cooked in bamboo, sold at the Silver Waterfall stalls and on the town grills. Peel the tube to eat.

spots.name: Grilled salmon
spots.note: Grilled Thác Bạc salmon with firm, tight flesh that eats rich and sweet, at the town grills and the falls restaurant.

spots.name: Village pork skewers
spots.note: Skewered village pork off the cold-night grills at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market.

spots.name: Grilled chicken wings
spots.note: Grilled chicken wings from the same lakeside grill spread.

spots.name: Beef rolled with enoki
spots.note: Beef rolled around enoki mushrooms and grilled at the lake stalls.

spots.name: Grilled eggs
spots.note: Grilled eggs at the town grills, sold as grilled chicken eggs under the trees at Silver Waterfall.

spots.name: Chestnuts
spots.note: Chestnuts off the grill, eaten with the meat and eggs on a cold evening.

spots.name: Salmon hotpot
spots.note: Salmon hotpot for the table at the Silver Waterfall restaurant and on several town menus.

spots.name: Salmon salad
spots.note: Salmon salad at the falls restaurant, Indigo, Cá Hồi Vua, and Anh Dũng.

spots.name: Salted salmon roe
spots.note: Salted salmon roe, a side plate at the restaurant by the falls gate.

spots.name: Salmon loin, mustard
spots.nameVi: Thăn cá hồi nướng sốt mù tạt
spots.note: Grilled salmon loin in a mustard sauce at the falls restaurant.

spots.name: Salmon floss
spots.note: Salmon floss to carry home from the falls restaurant and the cold-water fish yard.

spots.name: Son tra wine
spots.note: Táo mèo fruit wine, poured at the Silver Waterfall tree stalls and named with corn wine as a Sa Pa drink.

spots.name: Plum wine
spots.note: Plum wine, the second of the three drinks at the falls stalls.

spots.name: San Lung wine
spots.note: The third falls-stall drink, poured beside táo mèo and plum wine.

spots.name: Grilled corn
spots.note: Corn grilled over charcoal under the trees at Silver Waterfall.

spots.name: Grilled sweet potato
spots.note: Sweet potato roasted on the falls-stall grill beside the corn and eggs.

spots.name: Cap nach pork
spots.note: The small free-range highland pig, cooked many ways and served on a shared mẹt at Cá Hồi Vua, Anh Dũng, and Quý Bếp.

spots.name: Crisp stream fish
spots.note: Small stream fish fried crisp enough to eat the bones; Anh Dũng lists it.

spots.name: Corn cake
spots.note: Corn cake, one of the three local cakes with bánh đao and bánh dầy.

spots.name: Banh dao
spots.note: A highland cake, named with bánh ngô and bánh dầy among the Sa Pa cakes.

spots.name: Banh day
spots.note: A pounded glutinous-rice cake, the third of the Sa Pa cakes.

spots.name: Grilled beef loin
spots.note: Beef loin grilled with mushrooms or cải tai mèo; soft and sweet, with heat from the greens.

spots.name: Fish in bamboo
spots.note: Fish cooked in bamboo at Xá Phó family meals in thôn Nậm Sang, about 30 km south of town.

spots.name: Bamboo shoot with meat
spots.note: Bamboo shoot stir-fried with meat at the same Nậm Sang home meal.

spots.name: Bamboo shoot with garlic
spots.note: Bamboo shoot stir-fried with garlic, from the same Nậm Sang table.

sections.heading: International dining
paragraphs: Three town rooms add European cooking to a Vietnamese and highland menu.

spots.name: Indigo
spots.note: Open 09:00–23:59, averaging 150,000–300,000 đồng, with a view up to Fansipan and down to the Mường Hoa terraces. The menu runs from ngựa hầm hạt dẻ and gỏi cá hồi to lợn bản quay, gà hầm thuốc bắc, and lẩu cá tầm, with European, vegetarian, and dê Cốc Ly options.

spots.name: The Hill Station Signature
spots.note: Open 08:00–22:00, averaging 50,000–300,000 đồng, for Asian, European, and street-food cooking. Order chả giò Tây Bắc, canh rau đắng, gà nướng tiêu đen, or cá nướng; gà rừng nướng is billed as the specialty.

spots.name: Sapa New
spots.note: Vegetarian, European, and Vietnamese food in a room that stays busy through the day.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The lake and the road down to the market are the cold-night grills. The falls have the tree stalls, the salmon farm, and the restaurant at the gate.

spots.name: Ho Sa Pa grills
spots.note: Cold evenings bring out salmon, village-pork skewers, chicken wings, beef and enoki rolls, eggs, chestnuts, cơm lam, and beef loin with mushrooms or cải tai mèo. Order by the skewer and eat at the stall.

spots.name: Road down to the market
spots.address: The road down to the market
spots.note: The same cold-night grills carry on down the road from the lake to the market.

spots.name: Saturday market
spots.address: Town market and the square in front of the stone church
spots.note: On Saturday evening Hmong and Dao families gather to trade in the market and the square in front of the stone church.

spots.name: New market food floor
spots.nameVi: Khu ẩm thực chợ Sa Pa
spots.note: Upstairs at the new market, counters serve noodles, phở, and rice at everyday prices.

spots.name: Silver Waterfall stalls
spots.nameVi: Quán dưới tán cây, thác Bạc
spots.address: Silver Waterfall, about 12 km from town, under Ô Quy Hồ
spots.note: Cơm lam, grilled corn, grilled chicken eggs, sweet potato, and three wines, plum, táo mèo, and san lùng, under the trees. A listed gate fare is 20,000 đồng for adults and 10,000 đồng for children.

spots.name: Thac Bac restaurant
spots.nameVi: Nhà hàng thác Bạc Sa Pa
spots.note: A full salmon table near the falls gate: hotpot, salad, grilled salmon, salted roe, and grilled loin in mustard sauce, with salmon floss to take home.

spots.name: Thac Bac trout farm
spots.address: Right from the foot of Silver Waterfall; also given as tổ 14, Ô Quý Hồ, near the falls
spots.note: A short walk right from the foot of the fall, where you can see the fish. The yard smokes cá hồi vân hot and cold and sells ruốc cá hồi.

spots.name: Ca Hoi Vua
spots.address: 015A Lê Văn Tám, phường Sa Pa
spots.note: Open 09:00–23:59, averaging 50,000–650,000 đồng, for salmon and sturgeon hotpot, gỏi cá hồi, grilled salmon, grilled chicken, and grilled horse. The kitchen also cooks vịt trời, lợn cắp nách, and gà đồi.

spots.name: Anh Dung
spots.note: An everyday room open 09:00–22:59, listing gỏi cá hồi at 300,000 đồng, cá hồi sốt phô mai and gà nướng than hoa at 350,000, lẩu cá tầm at 600,000, and a full lợn mẹt at 1,000,000, against a listed average of 1,000,000 đồng. Thắng cố ngựa, lợn cắp nách, cá suối, greens, and Sa Pa mushrooms are on the menu too.

spots.name: Quy Bep
spots.address: 009 Lương Định Của, phường Sa Pa
spots.note: Open 08:00–23:59, averaging 50,000–600,000 đồng, for a six-dish mẹt lợn, steamed village pork, and black-chicken hotpot. Dê Cốc Ly goat is on the menu too.

spots.name: Gia Bao
spots.address: 1 Võ Thị Sáu, phường Sa Pa
spots.note: Open 10:00–22:00, averaging 50,000–1,000,000 đồng, for hotpot and grill: local beef, imported beef, seafood, and salmon or sturgeon hotpot.

spots.name: H'Mong
spots.address: 312 Điện Biên Phủ, near the market and the gas station
spots.note: A town restaurant on Điện Biên Phủ, near the market and the gas station.

sections.heading: Fine dining
paragraphs: Sa Pa eats at hotpot, grill, and buffet tables rather than tasting menus. For a sit-down dinner, use the casual and themed rooms.

sections.heading: Themed dining
paragraphs: Vân Sam is the Northwest buffet at the cable station. Nậm Sang is a meal in a family home, not a restaurant.

spots.name: Van Sam
spots.address: Floor 2, Hoàng Liên cable station, Sun World Fansipan Legend, Nguyễn Chí Thanh. Older listings say floor M.
spots.note: A Northwest buffet of 50 to 60-plus dishes, from grilled meats, steamed egg, vegetables, and cakes to bánh chưng đen, roast Tả Van duck, and thắng cố ngựa, in a hall of about 1,200 seats. Listings give Friday–Sunday 10:30–15:00, 11:00–15:00 after Tết, and 07:30–17:00 daily in 2018, with 170,000 đồng for adults and 135,000 đồng for children, one drink included.

spots.name: Nam Sang household meal
spots.nameVi: Cơm nhà Xá Phó, thôn Nậm Sang
spots.address: Thôn Nậm Sang, xã Nậm Sài, about 30 km south of town. The hamlet is about 2.5 km from the commune center.
spots.note: Any Xá Phó house can serve the meal: cá lam ống, bamboo shoots stir-fried with meat or with garlic, and dishes of black pork.

spots.name: Do Quyen
spots.address: 214 Thạch Sơn; also listed at the Fansipan summit, 3,143 m
spots.note: Asian and local cooking, open 09:00–22:59, with doors listed on Thạch Sơn and at the Fansipan summit.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: One town room serves breakfast on a seasonal menu.

spots.name: Ga 306
spots.address: 306 Điện Biên Phủ, near the market
spots.note: Breakfast, lunch, and dinner on a menu that changes with the season.

seoTitle: Sapa food guide — thang co, grills, and salmon
seoDescription: Thắng cố with corn wine, cold-night grills by hồ Sa Pa, and salmon at Thác Bạc, plus the Saturday square and the Xá Phó home meal at Nậm Sang.
